order_of_battle.definition: A roster of all units in the Crusade force.

supply_limit.description: The maximum combined points value of all units on the Order of Battle.

order_of_battle.supply_used: The current combined points value of all units on the Order of Battle. Cannot exceed Supply Limit.

requisition_points_rp.gain_rate: 1 RP per battle played (win, lose, or draw).

unit_management: Units can be added or removed at any time within the Supply Limit.
Removed units lose all acquired Experience Points (XP) and Battle Honours.
Summoned and Replacement units added during a battle are temporary and not permanently added to the Order of Battle.

crusade_cards.requirement: Each unit on the Order of Battle must have a Crusade card.
crusade_cards.restrictions: Once added, the number of models, wargear, and initial selectable rules cannot be changed unless specific Requisitions are used.

gain_methods.name: Battle Experience
gain_methods.condition: Awarded to each unit that was part of the Crusade army at the end of a battle.

gain_methods.name: Dealers of Death
gain_methods.condition: Awarded for every third enemy unit destroyed by the unit.

gain_methods.name: Marked for Greatness
gain_methods.condition: Awarded to one selected unit at the end of a battle.

experience_points_xp.ineligible_units_rules: These units never gain XP, Battle Honours, or Battle Scars (they automatically pass Out of Action tests).

ranks_and_promotions.rules: Units gain a rank and one Battle Honour upon reaching XP thresholds. Non-CHARACTER units cannot progress beyond Battle-hardened (30 XP) unless the Legendary Veterans requisition is used.

requisitions.name: Increase Supply Limit
requisitions.effect: Increase Crusade force Supply Limit by 200 points.

requisitions.name: Renowned Heroes
requisitions.cost_rp: 1-3 (1 RP + 1 RP for each other Enhancement on the Order of Battle)
requisitions.timing: When adding a CHARACTER unit or when a CHARACTER gains a rank
requisitions.effect: Give a CHARACTER one Enhancement. Replaces a Battle Honour if used upon promotion. Cannot be used on EPIC HEROES, units with existing Enhancements, or units with 'Disgraced' or 'Mark of Shame' Scars.

requisitions.name: Legendary Veterans
requisitions.timing: When a non-CHARACTER unit reaches 30 XP
requisitions.effect: Uncaps XP limit, allows promotion above Battle-hardened, and increases maximum Battle Honours for that unit to 6.

requisitions.name: Rearm and Resupply
requisitions.effect: Change any wargear options on a unit's datasheet. Replaced Crusade Relics or Weapon Modifications are lost.

requisitions.name: Repair and Recuperate
requisitions.cost_rp: 1-5 (1 RP + 1 RP per Battle Honour the unit has)
requisitions.effect: Remove one Battle Scar from a unit. Increases the unit's Crusade Points by 1.

requisitions.name: Fresh Recruits
requisitions.cost_rp: 1-4 (1 RP + 1 RP for every 2 Battle Honours the unit has, rounded up)
requisitions.effect: Add models to a unit up to its datasheet maximum.

battle_honours.rules: Increase unit Crusade Points by 1 (or 2 if TITANIC) per Honour. Maximum of 3 Honours per standard unit, 6 per CHARACTER unit. Categories include Battle Traits, Weapon Modifications, and Crusade Relics.

weapon_modifications.rules: Roll two D6 or choose two different modifications for one model's weapon. Cannot select Relics or Enhancements.

crusade_relics.rules: CHARACTER models only. Cannot duplicate the same relic on the Order of Battle.

out_of_action.trigger: At the end of a battle, test every destroyed unit.
out_of_action.test_mechanic: Roll 1D6. On 2+, test passed (unit is restored with no penalties). On 1, test failed (apply Devastating Blow or Battle Scar).

penalties.devastating_blow: Lose 1 Battle Honour. Decrease Crusade Points by 1 (2 if TITANIC). Must have at least 1 Honour to select.
penalties.battle_scar: Gain 1 Battle Scar. Decrease Crusade Points by 1 per Scar (can become negative).

battle_scars.rules: Roll 1D6 or choose. Max 3 Scars per unit. If a unit fails a test with 3 Scars, it MUST take a Devastating Blow. If it has no Honours left to lose, it is permanently destroyed and removed from the Order of Battle.

options.name: Crippling Damage
options.effect: Cannot Advance. Subtract 1 inch from Move characteristic.

options.name: Battle-weary
options.effect: Subtract 1 from Battle-shock, Leadership, Desperate Escape, and Out of Action tests.

options.name: Fatigued
options.effect: Subtract 1 from OC. Unit never receives a Charge bonus.

options.name: Disgraced
options.effect: Unaffected by Stratagems. Cannot be Marked for Greatness.

options.name: Mark of Shame
options.effect: Cannot form an Attached unit. Unaffected by Aura abilities. Cannot be Marked for Greatness.

options.name: Deep Scars
options.effect: Critical Hits scored against this unit automatically wound.

rules: Leader and Bodyguard units combine to form an Attached unit.
Battle Honours and Scars from individual components apply to the whole Attached unit, except for 'all models in unit' rules (e.g., Deep Strike, Stealth) which require both units to possess the rule.
Out of Action tests are taken individually for destroyed Leader or Bodyguard components.
Both individual units gain 1 XP for Battle Experience.
Combat tallies and bonus XP (e.g., Marked for Greatness) must be assigned to EITHER the Leader OR the Bodyguard, not both.

steps.details: Record army details to show opponent.

rules: Must be pulled directly from the Order of Battle.
Must match chosen Faction keyword and fit within point limits.
Rule of 3 applies (max 3 of the same datasheet), extended to 6 for BATTLELINE and DEDICATED TRANSPORT units.
DEDICATED TRANSPORTS must start with at least one unit embarked.

steps.details: Select one CHARACTER model to gain the WARLORD keyword.
